John / team - updated MAP attached (Acme_MAP_v1.1.docx). I incorporated the items we discussed on the call and proposed explicit owners and SLAs for legal milestones. Relevant excerpt (also updated in the attached table):

MAP legal milestone: 
- Milestone: "MSA initial redlines provided"
  - Owner: Redwood (Marissa / Redwood Legal)
  - Target: 3 business days from today for initial draft to Acme legal
  - Dependency: None (using Redwood standard MSA template)

- Milestone: "Acme legal counter-comments on MSA"
  - Owner: Acme Legal
  - Target: 5 business days from receipt of Redwood draft

- Milestone: "DPA / SLA negotiation"
  - Owner: Joint (Redwood drafts baseline DPA; Acme reviews SLA targets)
  - Target: 5 business days for initial counter-comments; follow-ups TBD per clause complexity

- Milestone: "Final sign-off"
  - Owner: Procurement / Legal (Acme) + Redwood Legal
  - Target: aligned with commercial close (target 2025-07-15)

Other notes: 
- Turnaround times above are our proposed standard; we can accelerate critical items but will need clear prioritization.
- For transparency I recommend we track redlines in a shared Google Doc (link in Drive) and tag the clause owner on each comment; for DocuSign / signature we'll hand off final executed PDFs.

Please confirm these owners and timeframes or propose edits. If Acme prefers to own the MSA initial redlines instead, we can switch owners but we'd ask for a 3 business day window from Acme to receive the first pass.

Thanks - next steps: I will post the MAP to the shared drive and ping procurement contacts once we lock the legal dates.

Best,
Marissa
